title: Sweet Potato and Kashkaval Burekas
subtitle: with a crisp parmesan coating
description: Layered filo triangles filled with mashed roasted sweet potato and kashkaval, topped with parmesan instead of sesame for a crisp, cheesy crust. Great for brunch.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 200°C. Prick the sweet potatoes with a fork, wrap each in foil, place on baking paper on the oven rack and bake for about 1 hour until soft. Reduce the oven to 180°C. Cool the sweet potatoes for 1/2 hour, remove the foil, halve them and scoop the flesh into a medium bowl. Add the kashkaval, salt and pepper and mash until combined.

Line a tray with baking paper. Cover the filo sheets with a damp towel so they do not dry out. Take one sheet, brush with olive oil, place another sheet on top, brush the top and cut the sheets into strips 9-10 cm wide and about 30 cm long.

Place 2 1/2-3 tablespoons of filling on the bottom of a strip, about 1 1/2 cm from the bottom edge. Fold the right corner over the filling to the side of the strip to form a triangle. Keep folding the triangle up and diagonally to the end of the strip to get a multi-layered triangle. Press the edges together and place on the tray with the fold facing down. Repeat with the remaining filo, oiling two sheets at a time, stacking, cutting into strips, filling and folding. Space them apart on the tray.

Brush with olive oil and sprinkle with the parmesan. Bake for 20-22 minutes and serve hot. They keep in the fridge for up to 3 days or the freezer for up to 3 months; thaw and reheat at 180°C for 8-10 minutes.
